text:
emma: FYI Partner Y dropped a new reference-arch + TF module for Redwood marketplace. Need a short technical gate checklist so we can onboard into cloud-partner.
raj: repo?
emma: https://git.internal/redwood/partnery/redwood-marketplace-starter — added a modules/ directory and a k8s example that targets GKE and EKS.
maria: First pass: ensure module follows our module conventions. Required: inputs documented, outputs: endpoint_url/security_group_id/instance_type, semver tag, and CHANGELOG.
chris: CI must run matrix for Terraform 1.3.x and 1.4.x, and a build job for multi-arch container images (amd64 + arm64). Also enforce `terraform fmt` and `tflint`.
jen (partner-eng): Marketplace package needs manifest + onboarding doc. Minimal manifest example:
```
{
  "id": "redwood-partnery-starter",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "maintainer": "partners@partnery.com"
}
```
emma: Add license check (LICENSE + signed CLA). We'll reject unlicensed modules.
raj: For images, require SBOM and provenance. Recommend GitHub Actions buildx with this command:
```
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/partnery/starter:0.2.0 --sbom=cyclonedx.json --push .
```
maria: Tests: unit-level terratest/kitchen checks for outputs + a lightweight integration that deploys the example app to a small node pool (cpu-only) in staging. Smoke should not need GPUs.
chris: Add a latency assertion in smoke: sample model response median <150ms on staging small instance. If we can't reproduce perf without GPU, mark as informational but still pass the gate if functional checks pass.
emma: Cost guidance in README required: expected monthly cost for demo (CPU path vs GPU path), recommended instance types, and note on reserved vs ephemeral.
jen (partner-eng): Packaging QA: partner-eng will run a manual install in our marketplace staging account and capture steps + screenshots. I'll attach the artifact.
marketplace-bot: package-scan report: critical: 0, high: 0, medium: 2, low: 4.
raj: CI gating: add `marketplace-gate` job that runs on PR. Fail the PR if `tflint`/`terraform validate` or `tests/smoke` fail.
maria: I'll draft a PR template for partner modules with a checklist section (module tests, example deploy, manifest, images+SBOM, license, cost notes). Will link the PR template here.
chris: We'll add a `ci/common.yml` job snippet for `marketplace-smoke` that hits staging endpoint and validates schema + latency threshold.
emma: Owners: Partnerships (final sign-off), partner-eng (install UX), eng-infra (CI config). Timeline: aim to merge by next Mon, stage publish Tue if QA passes.
jen (partner-eng): I'll run install tomorrow morning and post results. If anything blocks, I'll escalate to #release-war-room.
raj: lgtm
maria: lgtm
chris: :shipit:
emma: Thanks all — putting checklist in PR description now.
